حِنْزَابٌ An ass of middling make (مُقْتَدِرُ الخَلْقِ). (K.) ―
-b2- Also Short and strong: or broad: (K:) or short and broad; applied to a man: (Th, TA:) and thick, coarse, rude, or bulky, (K, TA,) and short. (TA.) [See حَزَابٍ, in two places.] ―
-b3- The cock. (K.) ―
-b4- Also, and ↓ حُنْزُوبٌ , A flock of [the kind of birds called] قَطًا: (K:) or the male of the قطا. (TA.) [See حنزاب in art. حزب.] ―
-b5- And both these words, The carrot of the land (جَزَرُ البَرِّ [see حنزاب in art. حزب]): (K:) n. un. of the former with ة: that of the latter is not known to have been in use. (TA.) ―
-b6- This is [said to be] the proper place of these two words; [the ن being regarded as a radical letter;] (K, TA;) not art. حزب. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
